data.headline: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: ASML vs. Taiwan Semiconductor
data.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been a boon to the semiconductor industry.  Two companies critical to the production of semiconductor chips are ASML (NASDAQ: ASML) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM), popularly known as TSMC.  The former produces lithography equipment used in making microchips for AI.
